comments: There are no specific comments on the publication. Cepheid moduli are compiled and homogenized from earlier HST Key Project and independent studies. Previous author included it.
Only 13 HST Cepheids with V,I data enter the fit, producing a comparatively large random uncertainty. No metallicity correction or host-specific systematic error is included.
Final Wesenheit fit; no period cut was required because all 13 Cepheids were retained. e_R contains random uncertainty only.
Table 4 mu_Z; all 13 Cepheids were retained. The metallicity correction uses gamma=-0.2 mag dex^-1 and its uncertainty is not included in e_R.
Not flagged as a preferred near-solar solution. Lowering Vlim by 0.5 mag changes mu by +0.39 mag. Table 6 reports 48 sosie matches, not an unambiguous count of distinct Cepheids.
HIPPARCOS-calibrated result. Its limiting-magnitude test gives an asymmetric change of +0.12/0.00 mag, contributing to the larger final uncertainty.
Maximum-light LMC PL solution used as a consistency check; it agrees with the mean-light result within 0.004 mag.
Representative LMC mean-light solution. CTE corrected but not metallicity corrected; random error only.
FSG03 Galactic result with a -0.040 mag metallicity correction, reversing the small uncorrected LMC-GC offset.
LMC solution with a +0.034 mag metallicity correction. The systematic uncertainty of gamma is excluded.
Representative FSG03 Galactic mean-light solution. CTE corrected without metallicity adjustment.
Final modulus from 13 Cepheids. The uncorrected GC/LMC values are 30.98/30.80 mag; metallicity corrections of -0.09/+0.10 mag yield 30.89/30.90 mag before adoption.
